messages.content: Auto sector revenue index: 89 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.

Business closing: Patricia Hawkins — request a private, off-calendar meeting with angela wright — not in her office, not at hq. invite her to lunch at a location off auto row. the agenda is not 'i know you're talking to an attorney.' the agenda is: i want her to tell me, in her own words, what she is seeing in the organization and what she thinks we should be doing. give her the conversational opening to be honest about her own position without forcing her to disclose. make clear that her role in a restructuring scenario — if there is one — is not to be eliminated, it is to be the architect of it. offer to discuss formalizing her participation in the strategic planning process with a defined retention agreement: 90-day stay bonus of $12,000, contingent on her leading the workforce transition plan, whatever form that takes.

Business closing: Patricia Hawkins — convene a closed-door session with rick tanner and the two other gms — not the broad all-hands, but the four people who run the floors. the agenda is one question: if new vehicle sales decline 40% over the next 18 months, what does a solvent, smaller version of regional auto group look like? i am not asking them to plan for closure. i am asking them to help me plan for a company that is half its current size but still viable. assign each gm to bring a single-page response next week: which of their current operations survive that scenario, and what would need to change. i will share the service audit results when they are complete. this meeting is not a decision — it is a pressure test.

Business closing: Rick Tanner — pull angela wright into a private conversation before she escalates her attorney situation further. don't address what i know — i can't, because the way i know it exposes how closely i've been watching. instead: tell her i'm thinking about how to protect the team heading into a volatile period, ask her what she would need to feel secure in her role over the next six months, and listen. the goal is not to stop her from leaving. the goal is to slow the signal she's sending to the rest of the floor. an hr director quietly consulting an attorney has a gravitational effect — people notice when the person who knows how severance works starts acting like she needs to know how severance works.

Business closing: Rick Tanner — run the floor at full intensity for the next 30 days. personally take the floor two afternoons per week — rick tanner on the lot, talking to customers, not just managing from the office. pipeline review every monday. push the team on closures before roboride launches, because the window of 'normal buying behavior' is closing and i know it even if the team doesn't. every deal we close in the next 30 days is a deal we close before uncertainty kills foot traffic.

Business closing: Tamika Jefferson — keep performing at the dealership without visible signal of exit planning. close cars. show up on time. be pleasant to rick. do not discuss job searches, freelance work, or maria's town hall at work. the $4,200/month income is still funding the bridge-build — every week i keep it is another week i can afford to take the right first client instead of any client. the exit is not this tick. the exit is when freelance income hits $2,000/month or when the dealership makes the first involuntary move — whichever comes first.

You Have a direct conversation with Carlos Ruiz about his EV retraining — specifically ask what parts and consumables the shop is going to need as they take on more EV and hybrid work. Frame it as a business question, not small talk: what do they currently source, where from, what's hard to get, what lead times look like for ADAS sensors, high-voltage safety gear, EV battery diagnostic tools. This is a customer discovery call disguised as a relationship maintenance call.. Savings grew by $470.
